# Trailmark

Trailmark applies a restrained outdoor-industrial color palette to Obsidian, with dark and light modes matched to each other. The recorded description emphasises clear, readable interface styling and subtle contrasts across panes, notes and typography, and states nothing about settings, plugins or platform support.

![Trailmark screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joshua-walls/trailmark-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Trailmark"
    author: "Joshua Walls"
    repo:   "joshua-walls/trailmark-theme"
    slug:   "trailmark"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/trailmark"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/joshua-walls/trailmark-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joshua-walls/trailmark-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a restrained outdoor-industrial color palette with matched dark and light modes. Present clear, readable UI styling and subtle contrasts across panes, notes, and typography for a focused workspace."
}
```
